children: Cenntro entered into a First Amendment to its Securities Purchase Agreement to increase its private placement to approximately $57.0 million, consisting of up to 15.12 million shares at $3.773 per share. The amendment was signed on September 14, 2026, and the private placement closed on September 15, 2026, yielding gross proceeds of about $57,047,760. Shares were sold to non-U.S. accredited investors under Regulation S. Cenntro plans to use proceeds for working capital and general corporate purposes.
